legends: InOctets - Received octets
OutOctets - Sent octets

metrics.label: InOctets - Received octets
OutOctets - Sent octets

kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_netstat_IpExt_InOctets IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_netstat_IpExt_OutOctets IS NOT NULL
| STATS InOctets_Received_octets = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_netstat_IpExt_InOctets)), node_netstat_IpExt_OutOctets_B = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_netstat_IpExt_OutOctets)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| EVAL OutOctets_Sent_octets = (-1 * node_netstat_IpExt_OutOctets_B)
| DROP node_netstat_IpExt_OutOctets_B
| SORT time_bucket ASC

legends: ListenOverflows - Times the listen queue of a socket overflowed

RetransSegs - Segments retransmitted - that is, the number of TCP segments transmitted containing one or more previously transmitted octets
InErrs - Segments received in error (e.g., bad TCP checksums)
OutRsts - Segments sent with RST flag
TCPRcvQDrop - Packets meant to be queued in rcv queue but dropped because socket rcvbuf limit hit
TCPOFOQueue - TCP layer receives an out of order packet and has enough memory to queue it

Retranssegs Segments Retransmitted That Is The Number Of TCP Segments Transmitted Containing One Or More Previously Transmitted
Inerrs Segments Received In Error E G Bad TCP Checksums

Tcpofoqueue TCP Layer Receives An Out Of Order Packet And Has Enough Memory To Queue It
